brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as an opaque PNG, 1792 x 1024 pixels (approximately 16:9), landscape, minimum width 1000 pixels.

Editorial content is ONLY this fixed article summary: 2026-11-11 game results and that day's B.PREMIER official game EFF rankings by position, top 3 per position. This is daily game data, not season averages or a prediction. Do not invent scores or claims.

Art direction: approved Japanese sports ink poster style, near-black #151A18 background, sharp lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory type and monochrome ink illustration, energetic hand-drawn crosshatching, torn dry-brush edges, very few elements, high contrast, strong mobile readability. Not a photograph, not photorealistic, no photo collage.

Subject: the real basketball player Charles Jackson (チャールズ・ジャクソン), selected randomly from the article's players, shown as an unmistakably hand-drawn athletic action illustration. His appearance was checked against the current official Kyoto Hannaryz profile portrait: short dense tightly curled black hair with a slightly squared top and closely tapered sides, dark skin translated into rich black-and-ivory ink values, strong thick brows, almond-shaped eyes, a broad straight nose, full lips, a substantial neatly shaped black beard covering chin and jaw and connected moustache, a long slightly rectangular face, wide muscular shoulders and powerful tall center build. Subtle simplified ink tattoo shading on his LEFT upper arm. Preserve these distinctive facial features; do not substitute a clean-shaven or long-haired generic athlete.

Composition: place Jackson prominently on the LEFT half, visible from head to mid-thigh with face large enough to recognize. Dynamic three-quarter view, torso turning toward the right, both hands naturally gripping ONE orange basketball near his upper waist/chest as he pivots to protect it after a rebound. Anatomically plausible arms and fingers; both hands clearly distinct. A logo-free unbranded dark jersey with simple ivory edging, no team name, no sponsor words, no player name, no jersey number. A broad sweeping lime brush arc behind the figure gives rotational energy. Keep head, ball and hands fully in frame. No other people, no crowd faces, no hoop or scoreboard, no logos. This is a generic imagined basketball action, NOT a recreation of an actual play on 11/11.

Typography on the RIGHT half with generous separation from the player and face: huge heavy Japanese sans serif headlines, crisp and highly legible, preserve exact glyphs. The main result headline is ivory; the EFF headline is lime; the smaller qualifier is ivory and must be easy to read.
Render ONLY the following exact text, no additional labels or numerical claims:
Small brand at the upper right: "バスケまとめ"
Date below brand: "2026.11.11"
Small league label: "B.PREMIER"
Main headline: "試合結果"
Secondary large headline: "当日のEFF"
Clear qualifier under that: "ポジション別TOP3"
Footer on a clean dark band, clearly readable, with sufficient edge padding: "イラスト（AI生成）" followed by "イメージ"

Do not display Charles Jackson's name, individual stats, appearance status, personal rank, performance claim or team score. No previous reference-image text or stats (no 38, no Culver). Avoid clutter, decorative nonsense text, extra fingers, fused hands, cropped headlines. All essential content should have at least 5% outer padding. Output one complete polished thumbnail only.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION
Edit Image 1, the finished black and lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is an OFFICIAL APPEARANCE REFERENCE ONLY of the real player Charles Jackson; do not paste any photographic pixels or logos from it.

Make one targeted identity correction to the illustrated player's head in Image 1: match Charles Jackson's facial features and hair in Image 2 more faithfully. In particular reduce the exaggerated tall coarse curls to his short dense tightly curled black haircut with a restrained slightly squared top and tapered sides, match his longer slightly rectangular face, broad straight nose, strong brows and full lips, and match the neatly shaped beard length and cheek/jaw outline in the reference. Keep the natural three-quarter action angle and focused expression of Image 1. Translate these real features entirely into the existing hand-drawn black/ivory crosshatched sports illustration style. Leave a clear margin between the top of his hair and the canvas edge.

Keep ALL typography exactly unchanged and legible: "バスケまとめ", "2026.11.11", "B.PREMIER", "試合結果", "当日のEFF", "ポジション別TOP3", "イラスト（AI生成）", "イメージ".
Keep the exact landscape dimensions, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B palette, brush background, generic pivoting basketball action pose, hands gripping one orange ball, logo-free jersey, and overall layout. No player name, no player statistics, no team logos or sponsor text, no additional people. The image is an imagined illustration, not a real game photograph or a recreation of any specific play. Deliver exactly one corrected opaque PNG.

Correction inputs: Image 1 = initial generated PNG; Image 2 = official Charles Jackson profile photo, appearance reference only.
